children: Analysts kept bullish ratings on Micron (MU), highlighting its push into 3D DRAM over 4F, leadership in DRAM, NAND and HBM, and focus on memory for AI products.

Micron (MU) unveiled an AI memory roadmap for vertical HBM—stacking DRAM on processors to boost bandwidth—targeting vHBM volume production in 2028 with three generations through 2030.
Micron (MU) shows long-term bullish setup: 50-day MA above 200-day MA. Stock trades ~9–10% below short-term averages; MACD below signal line, recent rise viewed as a rebound.
